gd_skills2_Roland.Action.A_DeployScorpio.name: Scorpio Turret
gd_skills2_Roland.Action.A_DeployScorpio.description: Gain the ability to deploy a Scorpio Turret that automatically fires at enemies.  The Scorpio Turret also has shields that can be used as cover.

gd_skills2_Roland.Adrenaline.Adrenaline_.name: Adrenaline - Roland
gd_skills2_Roland.Adrenaline.Adrenaline_.description: Roland gains adrenaline when he damages enemies or if one of his friends gets crippled.

gd_skills2_Roland.Infantry.Assault.name: Assault

gd_skills2_Roland.Medic.Cauterize.name: Cauterize
gd_skills2_Roland.Medic.Cauterize.description: Shooting team members heals them.  This effect also works with grenades and rockets.

gd_skills2_Roland.Medic.Fitness_HealUp.name: Fitness_HealUp

gd_skills2_Roland.Support.Stockpile.name: Stockpile
gd_skills2_Roland.Support.Stockpile.description: Players near the Scorpio Turret regenerate ammo for the weapon currently in their hands.

gd_skills2_Roland.Support.SupplyDrop.name: Supply Drop
gd_skills2_Roland.Support.SupplyDrop.description: The Scorpio Turret periodically fires out supply pickups to resupply players.

gd_skills2_Roland.z_DELETEDELETE.Detonat.name: Detonate

gd_skills2_Roland.z_DELETEDELETE.Scoprio.name: Scorpio Rockets
gd_skills2_Roland.z_DELETEDELETE.Scoprio.description: The Scorpio Turret fires homing rockets in addition to its regular attack.

gd_Skills2_Lilith.Action.PhaseWalk_melee.name: Melee cancels Phasewalk
gd_Skills2_Lilith.Action.PhaseWalk_melee.description: Using a melee attack while Phasewalking deals additional damage.

gd_Skills2_Lilith.ActionElemental.Corros.name: Corrosive Return

gd_Skills2_Lilith.ActionElemental.Incend.name: Incendiary Return

gd_Skills2_Lilith.ActionElemental.Shocki.name: Shocking Return

gd_Skills2_Lilith.Adrenaline.Adrenaline_.description: Roland gains adrenaline when he damages enemies or if one of his friends gets crippled.

gd_Skills2_Lilith.Assassin.PhaseStrike.description: Using a melee attack while Phasewalking deals additional damage.

gd_Skills2_Lilith.Controller.Striking.description: Your melee attacks can Daze enemies, reducing their movement speed and accuracy.

gd_Skills2_Lilith.Elemental.Intuition.name: Intuition
gd_Skills2_Lilith.Elemental.Intuition.description: Killing an enemy increases your movement speed and the experience you and your team earn for a few seconds.

gd_Skills2_Lilith.Elemental.Phoenix.name: Phoenix
gd_Skills2_Lilith.Elemental.Phoenix.description: Killing an enemy causes you to deal Fire Damage to nearby enemies and makes your shots not always cost ammo for a few seconds.  The Fire Damage increases with your Level.

gd_Skills2_Lilith.Elemental.Quicksilver.name: Quicksilver
gd_Skills2_Lilith.Elemental.Quicksilver.description: Increases your Fire Rate with all weapons.

gd_Skills2_Lilith.Elemental.spark.description: Increases your chance of causing Elemental Effects with Elemental Weapons.

gd_skills2_Mordecai.Sniper.CarrionCall.name: Carrion Call
